content.short: ORA is an on-chain AI oracle protocol on Mantle that enables smart contracts to access verifiable AI model outputs trustlessly.
content.description: ORA (formerly HyperOracle) is a trustless AI oracle protocol that enables smart contracts to consume AI model outputs with cryptographic verification guarantees. Using optimistic machine learning (opML) and zero-knowledge proofs, ORA provides on-chain verifiable inference from AI models like LLMs and image generators  allowing dApps to build AI-powered features without trusting a centralized AI provider. ORA is deployed on Mantle, making it the first network in the ecosystem to support native AI oracle capabilities for smart contract developers.
